lines.t: The sheep that wander far away,
I leave the ninety-nine today,
To seek the one who’s gone astray,
My love calls out, don’t hide, don’t stay.
I go out after you, my own,
Leaving all to bring you home,
Hear My voice, and quickly run,
For you are loved, My precious one.
In every tear, every fall,
Through every shadow, through it all,
I break the chains, I hear your call,
For you who know My voice, I’m here, never small.
I go out after you, my own,
Leaving all to bring you home,
Hear My voice, and quickly run,
For you are loved, My precious one.
No matter where you roam, you’re known,
In every heart, My love has grown,
Come back to Me, no more alone,
Forever safe, forever home.
I go out after you, my own,
Leaving all to bring you home,
Hear My voice, and quickly run,
For you are loved, My precious one.
Run to Me, hear My call,
You are loved, beyond all.
